text.en:
15th. OCTOBER, 2011 No. S 54

ACCOUNTING STANDARDS ORDER, 2010 (S 116/2010)

NOTIFICATION OF COMMENCEMENT In exercise of the power conferred by section 1 ( 1) of the Accounting Standards Order, 2010, the Minister of Finance, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 1st. August, 2011 as the date on which that Order shall commence. Dated this 15th. day of Syawal, 1432 Hijriah corresponding to the 13th. day of September, 2011. HAJI HISHAM BIN HAJI MOHD. HANIFAH Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Finance, Brunei Darussalam.
